tamilVoices.name: Aravinth Kumarasamy
tamilVoices.shortBio: A creative voice contributing to Singapore's Tamil arts and cultural landscape.
tamilVoices.story: Discover the journey, work and cultural contributions of Tamil artists in Singapore.Aravinth Kumarasamy represents the creative spirit within Singapore's Tamil arts community. Through artistic expression and cultural work, he contributes to keeping Tamil traditions visible while connecting them with contemporary audiences. His work reflects how art can help preserve language, identity and heritage while allowing new generations to experience Tamil culture in fresh ways.

tamilVoices.name: Mr. S. Chandra Das
tamilVoices.shortBio: A business leader contributing to Singapore's diverse entrepreneurial community.
tamilVoices.story: Explore the journey of Tamil entrepreneurs building businesses and creating opportunities.Mr. S. Chandra Das represents the contribution of Tamil Singaporeans to business and entrepreneurship. His journey reflects the role of enterprise in creating opportunities, building professional networks and contributing to Singapore's wider economy. Stories like his show how members of the Tamil community have participated in the country's development while maintaining strong cultural connections

tamilVoices.name: Jayanthi Sankar
tamilVoices.shortBio: A literary voice helping preserve and evolve Tamil writing in Singapore.
tamilVoices.story: Explore Tamil literature, storytelling and creative expression in Singapore.Jayanthi Sankar is a writer whose literary work contributes to Singapore's multicultural storytelling landscape. Through fiction and creative writing, she explores everyday experiences, identity, culture and life in a changing society. Her work demonstrates how literature can preserve cultural perspectives while also creating space for new ideas and conversations.

tamilVoices.name: Na Govindasamy
tamilVoices.shortBio: A Singaporean educator, writer and Tamil scholar who contributed to Tamil literature and digital Tamil development.
tamilVoices.story: Na Govindasamy was an educator, writer and lecturer at Singapore's National Institute of Education. He played an important role in Singapore's Tamil literary scene, writing plays, dramas and short stories, while also contributing to the development of Tamil computing and digital Tamil resources. His work connected education, literature and technology, leaving a lasting mark on Tamil culture in Singapore.

tamilVoices.name: Tharman Shanmugaratnam
tamilVoices.shortBio: A community contributor working to connect people and preserve cultural identity. His leadership and public service reflect Singapore's diverse and multicultural society.
tamilVoices.story: Learn about community initiatives and cultural preservation. Tharman Shanmugaratnam is a prominent Singaporean public figure who has served in senior public leadership roles. His Tamil heritage is part of Singapore's multicultural identity and reflects the country's diverse social fabric. His public career also represents the participation of Singapore's Indian and Tamil communities in the country's civic and public life.

tamilVoices.name: Shabir Sulthan
tamilVoices.shortBio: An award-winning Singaporean singer-songwriter, composer and performer who has helped bring Tamil music to wider audiences.
tamilVoices.story: Shabir Sulthan is an award-winning Singaporean composer, singer-songwriter and actor. He became the inaugural winner of Vasantham Star in 2005 and has built a career across Singapore and India. His music blends Tamil and South Asian influences with contemporary sounds, while his work has also connected Singapore's Tamil music scene with wider audiences. He is known for songs including Yaayum and for his contributions to Singapore's National Day celebrations.
